```{r Measurement Properties, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(psych) # for OMEGA
library(mice) #multiple imputation
library(apaTables) #Correlation Table

#read data
NDAT <- read_sav("nodeatt.sav")#load node attributes (wide format) - missing are blank - use for ERGMS
elist <- read_sav("PEAS_edgelist_nomissing.sav") #edgelist data (long format) ---note these are the final prepared files

IM <- c("PA1R", "PA4")
EN <- c("PA2R", "PA3")
RWAN <- c("RWAA1", "RWAA2", "RWAC1", "RWAC2", "RWAT1", "RWAT2")
SDON <- c("SDO1", "SDO2R", "SDO3R", "SDO4", "SDO5R", "SDO6", "SDO7R", "SDO8R")
PATN <- c("PAT1", "PAT2", "PAT3", "PAT4")
IAPN <- c("PA5", "PA6")
SAPN <- c("PA7", "PA8")

RWA_Ax <- c("RWAA1", "RWAA2")
RWA_Cx <- c("RWAC1", "RWAC2")
RWA_Tx <- c("RWAT1", "RWAT2")

SDO_Dx <- c("SDO1","SDO2R", "SDO6", "SDO7R","SDO8R")
SDO_AEx <- c("SDO3R", "SDO4", "SDO5R")

class(NDAT$Trump)

NDAT <- NDAT  %>% 
       mutate(PA2R = 7-PA2,
              PA1R = 7-PA1,
              SDO2R = 8-SDO2,
              SDO3R = 8-SDO3,
              SDO5R = 8-SDO5,
              SDO7R = 8-SDO7, 
              SDO8R = 8-SDO8) %>%
       mutate(
              ENV = rowMeans(select(.,EN)),
              IMM = rowMeans(select(., IM)),
              RWA = rowMeans(select(., RWAN)),
              SDO = rowMeans(select(., SDON)),
              PAT = rowMeans(select(., PATN)),
              IAP = rowMeans(select(., IAPN)),
              SAP = rowMeans(select(., SAPN)),
              Trump = na_if(Trump, 6),
              Obama = na_if(Obama, 6),
              Medu = na_if(Medu, 4),
              Medu = na_if(Medu, 11),
              Fedu = na_if(Fedu, 4),
              Fedu = na_if(Fedu, 11),
              RWA_A = rowMeans(select(., RWA_Ax)),
              RWA_C = rowMeans(select(., RWA_Cx)),
              RWA_T = rowMeans(select(., RWA_Tx)),
              SDO_D = rowMeans(select(., SDO_Dx)),
              SDO_AE = rowMeans(select(., SDO_AEx)))
              

#recode pedu as highest level of either parents' edu
NDAT$pedu[NDAT$Medu == 1 | NDAT$Fedu == 1  ] <- 1 
NDAT$pedu[NDAT$Medu == 2 | NDAT$Fedu == 2  ] <- 2
NDAT$pedu[NDAT$Medu == 3 | NDAT$Fedu == 3  ] <- 3

NDAT$Race_1[is.na(NDAT$Race_1)] <- 0 #recode NA's for Race White as 0.
NDAT$Ethnicity[is.na(NDAT$Ethnicity)] <- 1 #recode NA's for Ethnicity as 0

```

```{r and Descriptives, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

#need to impute data for ERGM models
node_att <- NDAT %>% 
             select(c(Gender, Grade, Race_1, Ethnicity, income, pedu, RWA, SDO, PAT, ENV, IMM, IAP, SAP, Trump, Obama, RWA_A, RWA_C, RWA_T, SDO_AE, SDO_D))

node_att$Trump <- as.numeric(node_att$Trump)
node_att$Obama <- as.numeric(node_att$Obama)
node_att$Gender <- as.factor(node_att$Gender)
node_att$Grade <- as.factor(node_att$Grade)
node_att$Race_1 <- as.factor(node_att$Race_1)
node_att$Ethnicity <- as.factor(node_att$Ethnicity)
node_att$income <- as.numeric(node_att$income)

NAI <- mice(node_att, m=5, maxit = 5, method = 'pmm', seed = 500)
NAI <- complete(NAI) 

```
